mostWorthwhile.text: The workshop design specifying makers’ power to choose tasks and stop unsafe work was most worthwhile: it made the distinction between ownership and practical control concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The care comparison identified an important unresolved burden but did not offer the concrete sharing proposal I expected.

surprise.text: Completing the care goal meant recognizing that care remains demanding and needs sharing, rather than actually setting out how to share it.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final link from workshop control to plural good lives felt broad rather than fully developed.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it developed these proposals more concretely; the distinction between ownership and actual control was engaging, but the care discussion left me wanting more detail.
